SELECT BOARD_NO , TITLE , CONTENT , WRITER , TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT , TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATE_DT FROM TB_BOARD WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND WRITER LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT BOARD_NO , TITLE , CONTENT , WRITER , TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT , TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATE_DT FROM TB_BOARD WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BOARD (BOARD_NO, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, REG_DT) VALUES ((SELECT NVL(MAX(BOARD_NO), 0) + 1 FROM TB_BOARD), #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BOARD SET DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
